response.sql:
WITH per_team AS (
    SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM manager_half
    WHERE g > 53
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_loss_rate)
FROM per_team;

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id across all years and half-seasons; each qualifying manager_half record contributes one loss rate to its team's average.
